gh_3277fbbd4ee12fed5e5bdd7e.title: [深圳] FinTax 诚聘 初级AI全栈开发工程师 薪资 10K-25K RMB
gh_3277fbbd4ee12fed5e5bdd7e.description:
公司介绍
FinTax是财税软件和服务提供商，团队成员为头部区块链公司前高管和四大会计师事务所的财税专家，具有丰富的财税理论和实践经验。
官网：www.fintax.tech

薪资福利待遇
薪资范围：10K-25K RMB（具体面议，按能力定级）
项目奖金：完成项目即发放项目奖金，多劳多得
餐饮补贴：午餐 + 晚餐补贴，每周下午茶
弹性工时：上下班不打卡，拒绝形式主义
成长空间：深度参与 AI 工程化与全栈项目，快速提升技术壁垒



- 工作地点：深圳南山
- 联系方式：lucy.tan@fintax.tech

工作性质
- 是否全职：是
- 是否远程：否
- 时区要求：GMT+8
  
岗位职责
1.使用 AI 编码工具辅助开发，负责前后端、数据库功能开发与 bug 修复；
2.参与测试、代码评审、基础 Docker 部署；
3.沉淀 Prompt 与项目文档，持续优化团队 AI 开发工作流。

任职要求
1.已毕业，理工科背景，211 本科/硕士，优先应届生 / 1-2 年工作经验，能够独立编写代码；
2.熟悉至少一门编程语言，Java 基础扎实优先；了解 SpringBoot、MyBatis、RESTful API；掌握基础前端技术，有 React 使用经验更佳；
3.掌握基础 SQL，熟悉 MySQL / PostgreSQL；熟练使用 Git；
4.使用过 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 编码工具；
5.具备项目作品，能够清晰讲解自己所负责的模块。

加分项
1.拥有 SpringBoot 实战项目经验；
2.有后台管理系统、ERP、财税类系统开发经验；
3.掌握 Docker、Linux、Apifox 等工具；
4.了解 Redis、权限控制机制；
5.对财税 ERP、Web3 领域感兴趣。


工作环境
1.高级写字楼，办公环境好
2.技术驱动、扁平化管理，拒绝无效会议与形式主义；
3.鼓励使用 AI 工具提效，团队共享最佳实践；
4.代码即简历：欢迎附上 GitHub 主页 / 开源项目，我们更看重实际能力；
5.弹性工时、不打卡，结果导向。

gh_32c4e9a9b5d6fa8d6dab1eb8.title: CMC Global - Ruby on Rails Tech Lead - Ho Chi Minh City - FT
gh_32c4e9a9b5d6fa8d6dab1eb8.description:
## Location

* District 7, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
* Full-time position

## Salary Expectation

* Up to 50,000,000 VND gross per month

## About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to join an international product team.

You will lead and mentor a team of 4–5 engineers, take ownership of technical direction, and collaborate with international Engineering and Product stakeholders.

Strong Senior Ruby on Rails Engineers who are ready to step up into a Lead role are also welcome.

## Requirements

* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails
* Strong understanding of Ruby, Rails conventions, and engineering best practices
* Experience with system design, architecture, REST APIs, and relational databases
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or SQL Server
* Experience with AWS and general cloud infrastructure
* Familiarity with Git and CI/CD deployment
* Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, responsive UI, and web development best practices
* Good English communication skills for working with international stakeholders

## Skills

### Must Have

* Ruby on Rails
* System design and software architecture
* PostgreSQL or another relational database
* AWS
* Git and CI/CD
* REST API design and implementation
* Technical leadership, mentoring, and code review
* Performance optimization, testing, and production support

### Ideally

* Docker
* Cloudflare
* Datadog or a similar monitoring service
* Algolia or a similar search service
* AWS Lambda and CloudFront
* Heroku
* Buildkite or another CI platform

## Responsibilities

### You’ll be responsible for

* Leading and mentoring a team of 4–5 engineers
* Driving the delivery of medium to large-scale projects
* Defining technical direction, architecture, and engineering standards
* Coordinating development work and managing technical roadblocks
* Working with Product Managers and international stakeholders
* Designing scalable, reusable, and maintainable systems
* Taking ownership of production availability, performance, security, and incident management
* Promoting testing, code quality, technical documentation, and continuous improvement
* Supporting the “you build it, you run it” engineering approach

## Why It Would Be Awesome to Work With Us

* Opportunity to build meaningful products for international users
* International product environment
* Training and career development opportunities
* Salary review twice per year or based on excellent performance
* 12 salary months plus Performance Bonus
* Extra benefits package of 16,000,000 VND per employee per year
* Premium healthcare insurance
* 12 days of annual leave
* Company trip and employee engagement activities
* Onsite opportunities in the United States, Europe, and Asia
* Working time: Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day

## Interesting Engineering Challenges

* Designing and evolving scalable Ruby on Rails systems
* Improving application performance and production reliability
* Defining modular and reusable system architecture
* Developing and maintaining APIs and database solutions
* Strengthening CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and incident management practices
* Balancing technical quality with product and business outcomes

## Contact

Phone/Zalo: 0346 239 089

Responsibilities
- Lead the team to develop the digital bank system from scratch
- Overall project management including planning, tracking, risk management, stakeholder management, quality assurance etc.
- Build and manage development teams across three countries: Japan, India, and Vietnam
- Build & tracking engineering process follow Scrum/Agile framework
- Taking responsibility for Scrum Master of the team
- Regularly communicate with development team members to resolve technical issues, manage progress, and ensure quality
- Participate in system design, contribute to system architecture, and handle integrations with third parties.
- Review code, provide insights, and set up coding standards for the project.
- Design system operations and maintenance with a view from the development stage to post-release
- After release, efficiently and safely conduct additional system development, operations, and maintenance
- Ensure regular reports to management.
